Sweep Tosho came to the museum to study 
the exhibited photos of the Umamusume who 
walked the Tiara route.

However, she becomes indignant when she 
overhears a spectator claim that runners 
from the Classic Triple Crown route have 
more raw strength than those from the 
Triple Tiara route.

Strong Umamusume are strong regardless of 
their background, yet it's infuriating 
that the world refuses to see it that way.

She would shatter stereotypes and wake 
everyone up. To that end, she resolved to 
discover the magic of racing and "change 
the world."
